description:
Fix the correctness bugs and harden the API in pkix-ct. CT is becoming mandatory in browser policies and increasingly expected in non-browser contexts.

Must-fix (from PKIX-d4h / PKIX-ppbr):
- verify_sct_for_cert treats every SCT as x509_entry (wrong for precerts, surfaces as InvalidSignature)
- tbs_without_sct_list relies on re-encoder bit-exactness (may fail on real-world non-canonical DER)
- verify_embedded_scts coalesces failures into count=0 with no diagnostic
- CtLog::usable_from_ms: None has conflicting documented meanings
- SctList inner Vec is pub (bypasses parser invariants)

Already fixed this session:
- #[non_exhaustive] on 4 public types + constructors
- serde feature + Send+Sync assertion

Acceptance: pkix-ct correctly verifies embedded SCTs and OCSP-stapled SCTs from real CT logs (Google Argon, Cloudflare Nimbus, Let's Encrypt Oak) for both x509 and precert entry types.
title: pkix-ct correctness and API hardening
